The reference index guest the fold suites run: it derives `seen/{height}/{seq}`
and `count` from the op feed.

Source: ducktape-sdk, the `index-guest` crate's testmap guest.

Three suites include these bytes — `crates/kernel/indexer/src/tests.rs`,
`crates/kernel/statesync/tests/remote_kv_sync.rs` and the explorer tests in
`bin/node/src/explorer.rs` — so the artifact is committed once, here.
